note: jquery_ui_sortable is a thin asset/library shim that re-supplies the jQuery UI Sortable library (removed from core) as the Drupal library id jquery_ui_sortable/sortable, filled in by the jquery_ui module. It has no config, permissions, services, plugins, or PHP API, so the only live state is: (a) the module being enabled, and (b) the jquery_ui_sortable/sortable library resolving to the vendored sortable-min.js asset. Easy cases are recipe (response-graded). Medium cases inspect the LIVE library registry. Hard cases uninstall the module (verify FAILS because the library no longer resolves) and require the agent to re-enable it so the library resolves again. Nothing else depends on jquery_ui_sortable on this site, so uninstall/enable is safe; baseline = enabled.

evals.prompt: In a Drupal 11 module/theme I need the jQuery UI Sortable behaviour that used to be at core/jquery.ui.sortable. Using the jquery_ui_sortable module, what is the exact asset library id I should attach instead, and how do I attach it to a render array?
evals.expected_output: The library id is jquery_ui_sortable/sortable. Attach it with $build['#attached']['library'][] = 'jquery_ui_sortable/sortable'; (or list it under dependencies: in a *.libraries.yml).

evals.prompt: Why would I install the jquery_ui_sortable contrib module on Drupal 10/11, and which removed core library does it replace?
evals.expected_output: jQuery UI was deprecated and removed from core; this module re-provides the Sortable library so legacy code keeps working. It replaces the removed core/jquery.ui.sortable library with jquery_ui_sortable/sortable.

evals.prompt: Which module does jquery_ui_sortable depend on to supply the actual jQuery UI files, and does jquery_ui_sortable have any configuration page or permissions?
evals.expected_output: It depends on the base jquery_ui module (which vendors the jQuery UI files and fills in the empty sortable library). It has no configuration page, no permissions, no services and no PHP API — you just enable it and attach the library.

evals.prompt: On this running Drupal site, confirm whether the jquery_ui_sortable/sortable asset library resolves, and tell me the path of the JavaScript file it loads.
evals.expected_output: The jquery_ui_sortable/sortable library resolves and loads the vendored jQuery UI file, e.g. modules/contrib/jquery_ui/assets/vendor/jquery.ui/ui/widgets/sortable-min.js.

evals.prompt: On this live site the jquery_ui_sortable/sortable library is only a stub that gets filled in. Inspect the resolved library and tell me which module actually supplies the vendored jQuery UI sortable JavaScript file.
evals.expected_output: The vendored file is supplied by the jquery_ui module — the resolved JS path is under modules/contrib/jquery_ui/assets/vendor/jquery.ui/... (jquery_ui_sortable declares an empty library that jquery_ui fills in).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site a theme attaches the jquery_ui_sortable/sortable library, but that library currently does not resolve (its module was uninstalled). Restore it so the jquery_ui_sortable/sortable library is available again. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable (install) the jquery_ui_sortable module (drush en jquery_ui_sortable) so the jquery_ui_sortable/sortable library resolves again.

evals.prompt: My site's drag-to-reorder widget broke because the jQuery UI Sortable JavaScript is no longer being provided. Get the jquery_ui_sortable module's sortable library working again on this live site so the sortable JavaScript file loads.
evals.expected_output: Enable the jquery_ui_sortable module and rebuild caches so jquery_ui_sortable/sortable resolves to the vendored sortable-min.js asset.
